name: Ω Architectural Immune System
purpose: Continuously detect architectural drift, orphaned features, unsafe truth upgrades and missing production controls before a concept is advertised as capability.
truthPolicy: Diagnostics are CALCULATED. A finding never changes production authority or truth state by itself.
hardRules: Never treat SIMULATED, LORE or DESIGN_PROPOSAL as LIVE.
Never permit a browser-only authority path for protected actions.
Never create a second WebGL renderer when a canonical renderer exists.
Never publish an outcome as verified without evidence.
Never silently replace a canonical system with a parallel subsystem.
